description: Defines the interface for ZoneInfoSource class and related factory function for handling timezone info data in the absl library.

classes.name: ZoneInfoSource
classes.description: Abstract class providing interface for reading timezone info data.

methods.name: ZoneInfoSource::Read
methods.description: Reads data into buffer, similar to fread.

methods.name: ZoneInfoSource::Skip
methods.description: Skips bytes in the data source, similar to fseek.

methods.name: ZoneInfoSource::Version
methods.description: Returns version info of the zoneinfo data, default implementation returns empty string.
